sources.boot_log: results/predictions/srv2d-volume-rowdump--*.jsonl came off the same volume read; the boot log's weight-loader bar ends at 2:07

rate.corroboration: five serverless endpoints billed on 2026-08-08 all read within 1% of $0.000307/s, srv-2c's included — the rate is settled even where the totals are not

measured.formula: parity_usd = rate x (the client's wall clock, submission of the info handshake to the last reply, so every queue delay is inside it, PLUS the 60 s idle timeout the worker bills after the last reply). usd_per_1000_rows = parity_usd / rows x 1000.

cross_check_against_the_balance.note: two independent readings of the same session: a settled per-second rate applied to measured seconds, and the account balance. They agree to about 1%.

pod_comparison.pod_source: results/serving_5b.json :: adopted — an A6000 pod, measured at 5b.1
pod_comparison.reading: the gap is the machine's price, not the model's speed: the RTX 4090 worker generates within a few percent of the A6000's per-row time, and bills about twice the pod's hourly rate

caveat_dv33: the RunPod balance delta lags the resource by minutes and the itemised ledger by hours (this endpoint's row had settled 1 538 s of 3 793 s when the session closed). Every figure here is a FLOOR, so the ratio against the pod is a lower bound.
